title: Cho tôi xin khăn giấy được không?
pronunciation: Cho toi xin khan giay duoc khong
summary: For asking for napkins or tissues at a table, stall, cafe, or counter.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it when the food is already on the table and you need napkins without turning it into a bigger request.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Point lightly to the table or your hands. Keep the request small and polite.

phrases.vietnamese: Cho tôi xin khăn giấy được không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cho toi xin khan giay duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Cho tôi xin is a polite asking frame; khăn giấy means tissues or napkins; được không asks if it is possible.

breakdown.english: may I have / please give me

breakdown.vietnamese: Cho tôi xin khăn giấy được không?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at street-food tables, cafes, casual restaurants, hotel breakfast, and takeaway counters.

phrases.vietnamese: Cho tôi cơm ăn kèm được không?
phrases.english: Can I have rice with this?
phrases.pronunciation: Cho toi com an kem duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Cho tôi xin chén súp riêng được không?
phrases.english: Can I have soup on the side?
phrases.pronunciation: Cho toi xin chen sup rieng duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Xin vui lòng cho nước sốt vào bên cạnh
phrases.pronunciation: Xin vui long cho nuoc sot vao ben canh

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Khăn giấy often covers the small paper napkins or tissues you are likely to need at a meal.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Use utensils, herbs, lime, chili sauce, rice, or sauce-on-the-side cards if the table needs one more thing.

phrases.vietnamese: Cho tôi xin chanh được không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cho toi xin chanh duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể dùng tương ớt được không?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the dung tuong ot duoc khong

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: If the table needs more, move to spoon and chopsticks, chili sauce, lime, rice, or more herbs follow-ups.

examples.vietnamese: Tôi có thể có khăn ăn được không?
examples.pronunciation: Toi co the co khan an duoc khong
